issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other - Water Fund 74,885.06 / Sewer Fund 95,893.67 (receipts[12])
issues.issue: Utility fund receipts; the user rule (2026-10-28) gives these the Utility Charges category. The Sewer part may include NDEE loan proceeds, which is already in decision_needed
Label has the fund name added; it is not the printed text (same for receipts[12] '(Sewer Fund)' and disbursements[4] 'Capital Improvements (Water Fund)')
Capital outlay rule: label should be 'Capital Outlay: <function>' with the printed text in printed_label (also disbursements[2] and [4] 'Capital Improvements')

beginning_cash/ending_cash already include investments (the line 3/24 roll-forward). beginning_investments/ending_investments are filled as well, so a reader adding cash and investments would double count 142,611.99 / 148,334.45
